Self.Wiki: An item pickup. The treasure places the items of its item lots as a glowing pickup at the treasure part, usually an item corpse. Taking it awards the lots and sets the lot's Get Item Flag, after which the pickup no longer appears.

TreasurePartName.Wiki: The part the pickup is placed at, normally an Object such as an item corpse. With no part, no pickup appears.

ItemLots.Wiki: The ItemLotParam rows given by the treasure (5 slots), -1 for an empty slot. Every retail treasure uses the first slot; about 30 also use the second and a few use more.
